name: How long does it typically take to design and construct a multi-generational living unit with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to design and construct a multi-generational living unit with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for designing and constructing a multi-generational living unit varies significantly based on the project's complexity, size, and existing home structure. A comprehensive addition, for instance, will naturally take longer than an interior conversion. Our managed process at AKN Design Group emphasizes clear communication, providing upfront estimates and transparent scheduling. We work diligently from initial design consultation and CAD-supported layouts through construction and final walkthrough, aiming for efficiency without compromising craftsmanship or quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines for multi-generational units vary based on complexity and scope. AKN Design Group provides transparent scheduling and upfront estimates, prioritizing efficiency and craftsmanship throughout the managed design-build process.
